remarks: Industrial land for sale at 5403 Sherin Road NW in Edmontons Kennedale Industrial neighbourhood. This approximately 1.35-acre, fully serviced property offers access to 50 Street and Yellowhead Trail. Zoned FD - Future Urban Development, the site presents potential for future development, with temporary outdoor storage identified as a discretionary use. Offered for judicial sale at $1,350,000, subject to court approval. (id:67522)
